items.action: Proposal: a reliable ping system (asked via Grok Bot, Oct 20)
items.approved: Requested Oct 20, 2026, 12:30 PM ICT. Advice only, not approved to build yet.
items.confirmation: Sent to Grok Bot. Pings stay on when everyone is paused. You do one Apps Script redeploy, then a test deck proves it works. One pinned routing table. Each ping is tracked until the board is actually cleared, re-sent once after 30 minutes, then flagged stuck. A read-only 15-minute safety check only alerts. The old router is retired. Security decides on the exposed key.
